result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a stray dark bar in the bottom navigation that is misaligned with the selected tab.

issues.description: A thick dark rounded horizontal bar sits inside the bottom navigation, running beneath the Search icon and extending toward the Orders icon. It does not align with the active Home tab (shown in green) and reads as a detached or misplaced tab indicator / rendering artifact.
issues.suggestion: Remove the stray bar, or move the active-tab indicator so it sits directly under the currently selected Home tab and matches the green active state.
